name: Least-Cost Hydrothermal Connectivity (graph/circuit-theory structural transfer)
lane: GEMSDOE33 analog-field and hydrothermal-conduit structural transfer
method_paragraph: Build a label-free resistance (cost) surface over the full footprint from GeoDAWN conductivity (cond_surf, cond_surf_gms2), gravity horizontal-gradient/slope (iso_grav_anom_hg, iso_grav_anom_slope), geodetic shear/dilatation rate (geod_shearrate, geod_dilaterate), and a basement-structure edge derived as the horizontal-gradient magnitude of depth_to_base_surf. Percentile-rank each channel using ONLY the fold-visible TRAIN region, average the ranks into a favorability field, and invert to a cost field. Downsample to a 300 m (3x) grid matched to the DTI triangular-kernel radius; build an 8-connected resistance graph; identify independently documented, catalogue-free thermal/volcanic manifestation points (INGENIOUS DOE GDR #1391 Hot-class wellspring cells plus volcanic vent cells, dist_known_fault_px column never read) and merge adjacent records into up to 90 member-weighted clusters; run multi-source Dijkstra among cluster nodes, build a minimum spanning tree over the pairwise cost-distance matrix, keep the shortest 85% of MST edges, and trace each kept edge's shortest path, scoring every traversed pixel by a directness ratio (straight-line distance / cost-weighted path length). Upsample to 100 m, blend with a LiDAR-coherence/relief/TMI-horizontal-gradient corroboration rank (neutral 0.5 multiplier inside LiDAR voids), and rank-normalise to [0,1]. The candidate surface never reads labels.tif or existing_faults.tif anywhere in its construction; the only catalogue contact in the whole pipeline is the standard shared per-fold visible-catalogue exclusion mask applied before emission, identical to every other lane.
why_it_differs_from_every_local_hypothes: H19-5 is curvilinear per-pixel scarp-trace detection; A33-L1 is a target-aligned analog-domain-adaptation classifier; A33-R2-CSHT is a 3-model (34/24/16-channel) HistGradientBoostingClassifier fused surface; H33-6 is multi-field gradient-vector-alignment consensus; H33-D/H33-F are geometric catalogue-tip/analog grafts; G33-H-N1 is a sparse local tilt x gravity x LiDAR product. None of these constructs a GLOBAL graph-theoretic minimum-cost connectivity tree between independently documented non-fault thermal/volcanic manifestation points. This is the first use of scipy.sparse.csgraph Dijkstra/minimum-spanning-tree connectivity anywhere in this repository's GEMSDOE33 history.
named_non_fault_mimic: Buried intrusive/caldera margins, Lake Lahontan paleo-shoreline benches, and conductive sedimentary basin fill can all produce a low-cost corridor between two hydrologically or thermally connected points that is not actually a tectonic fault.
decision_rule: PROMOTE only if: (1) zero leakage canary trips (two-sided AUC <= 0.90) across all cost/corroboration/basement-edge/final-surface channels; (2) primary quadrant-buffered-15px-v1 screen pooled HOLDOUT-DTI beats both the in-run and recorded B1_regional incumbent with a strictly positive 95% paired block-bootstrap CI and >=3/4 fold wins; (3) the independent diagonal-wedge-buffered-20px-confirm-v1 confirmation, frozen before screen results are inspected, repeats all three screen conditions; (4) both the pre-placement surface and the final CELF-300m placed dots pass the 21-raster registry uniqueness screen (max |Spearman rho| <= 0.90 AND max fraction of candidate dots within 3 px of any one registry raster <= 0.70). A failure of any gate is reported as a negative deliverable; this script never spends a weekly submission slot and never claims a projected competition score.
budget: At most 3 experiments (1: screen, 2: confirmation, 3: full-footprint deployment/placement/uniqueness) within a 2-hour wall-clock cap; no post-hoc retuning after the screen is inspected.
shared_template_reuse: Reuses vendor/gems24_template/holdout.py (SegmentHoldout, canary, pooled_bootstrap, spatial_components), src/gemsdoe33/csht_transfer.py (load_thermal_vent_seeds, DiagonalSegmentHoldout, make_diagonal_wedge_folds, celf_emit_300m, percentile_rank_surface, audit_uniqueness_against_manifest), src/gemsdoe33/analog_invariant.py (fit_regional_expert/predict, unchanged, for the B1_regional incumbent), src/gemsdoe33/promotion.py (assess), and submission_writer.write_pair / validate_submission.audit verbatim. No private fork of any shared evaluator, writer, or validator.
